title: An analysis of aerodynamic properties of delta wings
summary: We consider a sharp-edge delta wing of small aspect ratio $A>0$, which is an example of a 3D airfoil whose aerodynamic properties cannot be modeled using the potential lift}only. An important role is played by a pair of attached vortices, which generate the vortex lift. We review in detail the leading-edge suction analogy, developed by Edward Polhamus (NASA Technical Note D-3767, 1966), which shows that the most accurate description of the vortex lift can be obtained by avoiding any direct analysis of vorticity of the flow around the wing.
